full_prompt_en: The square image is a minimalist painted portrait of a woman in right-facing profile, set against a pale grey-green background. Her head and shoulders occupy the centre and right side, with the face tilted downward and the eyes lowered. Thick black hair is gathered into a loose bun at the back of the head, while a few long strands fall beside the cheek and neck. The hair forms a large dark shape across the upper half, with subtle grey highlights following its curves. Her pale face is constructed from broad smooth planes, with a gently defined brow, lowered eyelid, straight nose and closed muted red lips. A soft shadow under the cheek and chin separates the profile from the light background without a hard outline. At the neck, a white shirt collar folds outward in two clear angular points. A narrow orange-red tie descends from the collar into the black upper garment. The dark jacket covers the lower-left and lower-right portions, its shoulder edges blending into the image boundary. The white collar and warm tie are the only bright accents against the charcoal clothing and hair. The background is nearly uniform, with faint cool variation and no distinct setting or objects. Lighting is even and diffuse from the front-left, creating gentle tonal shifts across the cheek, nose and neck while keeping the black areas soft rather than glossy. The profile is cropped close, leaving little empty margin above the hair and shoulders. Clean shapes, restrained colours and broad areas of uninterrupted tone give the portrait a flat, graphic quality. No readable text appears. The white collar makes a sharp light wedge between the lower cheek and dark jacket, while the tie forms a narrow vertical strip that ends at the crop. Several angular grey brushstrokes on the hair suggest reflected light without breaking its solid silhouette. The profile’s nose and lips remain modestly defined, and no jewellery or other accessory interrupts the clean outline. The pale background is brightest behind the forehead and neck, giving the head a quiet separation from the surrounding empty field. The shoulder line slopes down toward the lower-left corner, giving the cropped pose a quiet diagonal direction. The backdrop has faint brush texture but no distinct ornament. The overall composition emphasizes the downward gaze and diagonal fall of the hair, balancing a pale profile against the dark clothing and hair with the small orange-red tie as a focused accent.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的极简绘画肖像：一位女性以朝右的侧面呈现，背景为浅灰绿色。她的头部与肩膀占据中央和右侧，脸微微低垂，目光向下。浓密黑发在脑后挽成松散发髻，几缕较长发丝沿面颊和颈侧垂下。头发在上半部形成大片深色形体，细微灰色高光沿着发丝弧线延伸。苍白面部由宽阔平滑的色面构成，可见柔和眉弓、低垂眼睑、直鼻和闭合的低饱和红唇。面颊与下巴下方的浅影让侧脸从浅色背景中分离，却没有硬朗描边。颈部有一件白衬衫领子向外翻折，形成两个清楚的棱角。窄窄的橙红色领带从领口垂入黑色上衣。深色外套覆盖画面左下和右下，肩线在接近画框处融入边界。白领和暖色领带是炭黑衣物与头发前唯一明亮的强调。背景几乎均匀，仅有淡淡冷色变化，没有明确场景或其他物件。光线从左前方均匀漫射，在面颊、鼻子与颈部形成柔和明暗变化，同时让黑色区域保持柔软而非发亮。侧面取景较近，头发与肩膀上方几乎没有多余留白。干净形体、克制配色和大面积连续色调赋予肖像平面化图形质感。画面中没有可读文字。白色领口在下方脸颊与深色外套之间形成清晰的浅色楔形，领带则成为一条窄竖带，并在画框裁切处结束。头发上几道带棱角的灰色笔痕暗示反光，却没有打破整块剪影。侧脸的鼻子和嘴唇刻画含蓄，没有首饰或其他配件打断简洁轮廓。额头和颈部后方的浅色背景最亮，使头部从周围空旷底色中安静分离。肩线向左下角倾斜，为被裁切的姿态带来安静的斜向走势。背景带有细微笔刷肌理，没有明确的装饰图形。整体构图强调低垂目光与头发的斜向走势，以浅色侧脸平衡深色衣物和头发，并让一小段橙红领带成为集中的色彩点。
style_prompt_en: The minimalist painting style uses broad flat planes, clean silhouettes and a limited palette of charcoal, pale grey-green, ivory and one restrained warm accent. Broad, softly connected tonal planes define the central form, with occasional angular brush marks interrupting otherwise continuous surfaces. Dark masses occupy large continuous areas, while light contours and narrow colour strips create clear separation. The background remains quiet and nearly uniform, keeping attention on the cropped forms and their graphic arrangement. The overall treatment is minimal and composed, balancing simple geometry with subtle tonal softness.
style_prompt_zh: 极简绘画风格以宽阔平面、清晰剪影和有限配色为主，色彩包括炭黑、浅灰绿、象牙白与一处克制暖色。宽阔且柔和衔接的色调平面界定中央形体，偶尔出现的棱角笔痕打破其余连续表面。深色块面占据大面积连续区域，浅色轮廓与窄色带则形成清楚分界。背景安静而近乎均匀，使注意力集中在裁切与图形关系上。整体处理极简而平稳，在简单几何与细微调性柔和之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Downward-looking woman with dark hair, a white collar and rust-red tie
theme_zh: 黑发低头女子、白翻领与锈红领带
name: Jarek Puczel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
